description: This file defines a handler class for managing OpenAI Text-to-Speech requests with guardrail support, focusing on processing text inputs by applying guardrails and acknowledging that output is audio data which does not require guardrails.

classes.name: OpenAITextToSpeechHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing OpenAI Text-to-Speech requests with guardrail support, capable of preprocessing input text for guardrail application and bypassing output guardrails as output is audio data.

methods.name: Any process_input_messages( self, data: dict, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the input message data by applying guardrails to the 'input' text, modifying the data dictionary accordingly.

methods.name: Any process_output_response( self, response: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent", guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, user_api_key_dict: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the output response, which is audio data, and returns it unchanged since guardrails are not applicable to binary audio outputs.
